ui_label: Horizontal grid cell with a tripolar grid type.
description: This horizontal grid cell describes the x-velocity (U-point) staggered location of the MOM6 tripolar ocean grid, sharing the same configuration as the mass (h-point) grid g260. It has 360 longitude points and 312 latitude points, with the same latitude rows as g260, offset by half a grid cell eastward in longitude. After removing the duplicate periodic column at the zonal boundary, the grid yields 112,320 unique cells. The tripolar fold is positioned at 65°N, consistent with g260.
